content.text: Panjpar (Five Cards) is a two-player Afghan beating game related to Durak. Players attack with 1, 3, or 5 cards; the defender beats or picks up. Draw to five from stock. First to empty hand wins. Featured in Khaled Hosseini's The Kite Runner.
Popular Afghan two-player card game. 'Panjpar' means five cards. Closely related to Russian Prostoy Durak but uses a full 52-card pack.

Two players. A standard 52-card pack is used; each player receives five cards. The next card is turned face up for trump and the remainder form the stock. Before the deal, one player guesses the trump colour; the correct guesser attacks first.

Five cards to each player. Next card turned face up = trump. Remainder stacked face down on trump card (trump visible) = stock. Before deal, one player guesses trump colour; correct guesser attacks first.
